story.headline: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif on Thursday launched the Mehfooz Dawa app in Islamabad, which lets people scan a medicine's batch number to check against a database of around 92,000 medicines whether it is genuine (green screen) or fake (red screen), lodge complaints and report shortages, Dawn reports.
